paragraphs: Irish Rail has new plans for trains in the west of Ireland. The boss of Irish Rail, Mary Considine, spoke about them on Friday.
The company wants a second track between Limerick Junction and Limerick city. Then up to five trains could run each hour in each direction. This new line could open in 2032.
An old line from Limerick to Foynes is open again for tests. Goods trains will use it first, in early 2027. Later, people can travel on it too.
In Galway, the main station is getting bigger. It will have five platforms, not two. Considine says better trains can bring new jobs and homes to the west.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭鐵路公司為愛爾蘭西部的火車制定了新計畫。
愛爾蘭鐵路公司負責人瑪麗·康西丁週五談到了這些計畫。
公司希望在利默里克樞紐站與利默里克市之間增建第二條軌道。
屆時每個方向每小時最多可開五班火車。
這條新線路可能在2032年啟用。
一條從利默里克到福因斯的舊鐵路已重新開放進行測試。
2027年初將先由貨運列車使用。
之後，民眾也可以搭乘。
在高威，主要車站正在擴建。
它將有五個月台，而不是兩個。
康西丁說，更好的火車能為西部帶來新的工作和住宅。

paragraphs: Irish Rail says new railway plans could change the economy and help build more homes in the west of Ireland. Its chief executive, Mary Considine, shared the plans on Friday.

The company has signed a contract with two engineering firms to plan a double track between Limerick Junction and Limerick city. With two tracks, up to five trains an hour could run in each direction. Irish Rail hopes to get planning permission by 2028 or 2029, and the line could open by 2032.

Other work is already happening. The old freight line from Limerick to Foynes is being tested and should open in early 2027. Passenger trains will come later. In Galway, a €70 million project will give Ceannt station five platforms instead of two.
A line from Athenry to Claremorris through Tuam may also reopen, with services planned for 2030 or 2031. Irish Rail says it will spend about €4 billion in the next four years across the country.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭鐵路公司表示，新的鐵路計畫可能改變經濟，並幫助愛爾蘭西部興建更多住宅。
執行長瑪麗·康西丁於週五公布了這些計畫。
公司已與兩家工程公司簽約，規劃利默里克樞紐站至利默里克市之間的雙軌鐵路。
有了兩條軌道，每個方向每小時最多可開五班火車。
愛爾蘭鐵路希望在2028或2029年取得規劃許可，該線路可能在2032年前啟用。
其他工程已在進行中。
從利默里克到福因斯的舊貨運線正在測試，預計2027年初開通。
客運列車將稍後加入。
在高威，一項七千萬歐元的工程將讓Ceannt車站擁有五個月台，而不是兩個。
經圖厄姆、從阿森萊到克萊爾莫里斯的線路也可能重新開放，預計在2030或2031年提供服務。
愛爾蘭鐵路表示，未來四年將在全國投入約四十億歐元。

paragraphs: Irish Rail believes a major investment in railways could transform the economy and boost housing in the west of Ireland, its chief executive Mary Considine said on Friday.

The company has signed a contract with the consultancy firms Aecom and Jacobs to bring its plan to double the track between Limerick Junction and Colbert station in Limerick city to the planning stage. The upgrade would allow up to five trains an hour in each direction. Planning permission is expected in 2028 or 2029, and the new line could be in operation by 2032.
